title: Copy a class link without opening the class

steps.say: **Copy link** in a class's row hands you that class's join link without opening the class at all.
The button says it has copied, and the link is then yours to paste into an email or a lesson slide.
It is the same link the class page offers, so a student who follows it lands in that class either way.
steps.terminal: That's copying a class link — one tap, from the list. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
